+@pytest.mark.parametrize('filter_name, expected_number, expected_letter',
+                         [('min', 1, 'a'), ('max', 2, 'w')])
+def test_min_max_without_keywords(filter_name, expected_number, expected_letter):
+    filter_func = getattr(ms, filter_name)
+    assert filter_func(env, (1, 2)) == expected_number
+    assert filter_func(env, (2, 1)) == expected_number
+    assert filter_func(env, ('p', 'a', 'w', 'b', 'p')) == expected_letter
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('filter_name, expected_mount', [('min', 'small'), ('max', 'large')])

+    result = getattr(ms, filter_name)(env, mounts, attribute='block_total')
+    assert result['name'] == expected_mount
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('filter_name, expected_name', [('min', 'upper'), ('max', 'lower')])
+def test_min_max_forwards_case_sensitive_keyword(filter_name, expected_name):
+    values = [{'name': 'lower', 'key': 'a'}, {'name': 'upper', 'key': 'B'}]
+    result = getattr(ms, filter_name)(env, values, attribute='key', case_sensitive=True)
+    assert result['name'] == expected_name
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('filter_name', ['min', 'max'])
+def test_min_max_without_enhanced_jinja_uses_builtin(filter_name, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ms, 'HAS_' + filter_name.upper(), False)
+    assert getattr(ms, filter_name)(env, [2, 1]) == (1 if filter_name == 'min' else 2)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('filter_name', ['min', 'max'])
+def test_min_max_without_enhanced_jinja_rejects_keywords(filter_name, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ms, 'HAS_' + filter_name.upper(), False)
+    with pytest.raises(AnsibleFilterError) as error:
+        getattr(ms, filter_name)(env, [2, 1], attribute='number')
+    assert error.value.message == ("Ansible's %s filter does not support any keyword arguments. "
